issues.problem: The towel rack sits immediately behind the water station with its front facing the station, leaving its usable side obstructed and towels difficult to reach.
issues.fix: Move the towel rack beside the water station and face its bar toward open floor space, keeping the gap between the objects within the required 0.2 m.

issues.problem: The full-length mirror starts 1 m above the floor, making it unsuitable for checking lower-body position and exercise form at normal nearby viewing distances.
issues.fix: Lower the mirror so its bottom is approximately 0.2–0.3 m above the floor.
